regional_summary_6h.headline: Israeli strikes in southern Syria and Bulgarian border security actions dominate regional risk
bullets: Israeli forces destroyed farmland and caused casualties in southern Syria, escalating military conflict near Turkey's southern flank.
Bulgarian and Ukrainian security services detained a drug trafficking organizer, highlighting cross-border illicit flow pressures on Turkey's northwest border.
Armenian political instability continued with arrests and releases of officials, though no direct border escalation with Turkey was reported.
regional_summary_6h.watch: Monitor for spillover from Syrian strikes into Turkish border zones and increased smuggling attempts via Bulgarian routes.
